sections.heading: 🌍 Tono macro
sections.content: El tono de la sesión se inclina firmemente hacia un entorno risk-off en los mercados asiáticos y de criptoactivos, a medida que las preocupaciones sobre el crecimiento en Asia se combinan con el repunte de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de EE. UU. Los mercados también están digiriendo un amplio trasfondo macroeconómico que incluye titulares geopolíticos en torno a una confirmada cumbre Xi-Trump-Putin y los ajustes en curso en el sector tecnológico.

sections.heading: 🛢 Mesa de petróleo
sections.content:
Crude benchmarks edge higher in early trading with WTI at 88.93 and Brent at 96.11, supported by a 1W gain of 2.8% and 3.6% respectively. Persistent energy cost pressures continue to bite globally despite weaker broader macroeconomic indicators out of Asia.
Cross-asset read
US 10Y yields climb 5.1bp to 5.154% while the DXY holds steady at 103.42, keeping downward pressure on precious metals like Gold at 3,858.70 and Silver at 47.41. Equity indices diverge, with the Dow resilient up 0.10% while tech-heavy gauges like Nasdaq 100 drop 1.22% and Nikkei 225 falls 2.42%.
Potential scenarios
▼ Bearish · Nikkei 225 — below 59,500 opens 58,000 · invalid above 60,200
Unexpected third-quarter economic contraction driven by elevated energy costs.
▲ Bullish · WTI — above 89.00 opens 92.50 · invalid below 87.50
Continued weekly momentum pushing crude prices higher amid steady demand.
▼ Bearish · Bitcoin — below 64,500 opens 61,500 · invalid above 67,000
Broad risk-off sentiment extending weekly losses across major cryptocurrencies.
▲ Bullish · Dow — above 52,400 opens 54,000 · invalid below 51,800
Outperformance relative to tech peers as defensive rotation supports the index.
Key risks
• Hawkish policy signals or unexpected remarks during Fed Chairman Warsh's scheduled speech.
• Further fallout from disappointing economic data prints coming out of China and Japan.
